history.summary: Lowest-quantum entry in the batch ($1.0M) and below-median PSF ($1366 vs $1411), but the location is the dealbreaker for an investment hold: 1.2km from only Kangkar LRT, no MRT walking distance. The 5.41% CAGR is the weakest in the batch, confirming muted demand. Resort-style landscaping is a livability plus, not an investment thesis.
history.rating_rationale: Affordable $1.0M quantum and a sub-median PSF make it look cheap, but cheapness here reflects a connectivity penalty rather than value. The nearest rail is Kangkar LRT 1.2km away — no MRT within walking distance, which structurally suppresses both tenant demand and the resale buyer pool. At 5.41%, its resale CAGR is the lowest of all ten condos despite 139 transactions, signalling genuinely softer appreciation rather than a data artefact. Build quality and quiet, well-landscaped environment are real but are own-stay merits. For a 5-7yr investment hold the exit liquidity and growth case are simply weaker than the better-connected peers.

history.summary: Low-quantum ($800k) 1BR in a well-reviewed D19 project, asking $1,282 psf near the bottom of the verified $1,247-1,557 psf range — a modest but real discount with steady demonstrated appreciation and a 2030 CRL catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: The web verifies the algo's cheapness as real-but-modest: Boathouse's 12-month range is $1,247-$1,557 psf (avg ~$1,406), and this 624 sqft 1BR asks $1,282.05 psf ($800k) — toward the low end, and notably a 1BR (smaller units normally command HIGHER psf), so $1,282 for a 1BR is genuinely on the cheaper side. The dossier's psf_premium_vs_cohort of -4.7% on 10 txns is honest and well-supported (decent cohort depth, modest discount), and age_adj_premium of -25.1% reflects a fairly-priced 2015 leasehold. Project quality is good (8.3/10, higher ceilings, resort facilities, no major defects). D19 is OCR with stronger realized forward returns than CCR (v3.4 region prior), demonstrated +10.76% PSF growth 2023-26, and the Cross Island Line (Hougang NEL interchange, ~2030) is a confirmed dated catalyst. The $800k quantum keeps liquidity and yield healthy for a 1BR. Not Strong Buy because the discount is only modest (~5% vs cohort) — this is fair-to-slightly-cheap rather than a steal — but the combination of low quantum, verified pricing, region tailwind and a real MRT catalyst justifies a Buy.
red_flags: Discount vs same-size cohort is modest (-4.7%) — this is fairly priced, not a deep bargain
99-year lease from 2011 (~84 yrs left) — lease decay clock is running
624 sqft 1BR — smaller exit segment, though low $800k quantum mitigates liquidity risk
catalysts: Cross Island Line Phase 1 (~2030) with Hougang NEL interchange — confirmed, dated regional connectivity upgrade for D19

Demonstrated steady appreciation (+10.76% PSF 2023-26) and OCR region with stronger forward returns than CCR
